responsibility: This file implements full expression folding for the C front end after initial parsing and tree construction. Its `c_fully_fold` logic recursively folds C expression subtrees with C-specific constant-expression rules, initializer restrictions, short-circuit and unevaluated-subexpression handling, overflow-warning suppression, and lvalue preservation, including special cases such as string constant array indexing, so that later semantic checks and gimplification see trees normalized according to C front-end semantics rather than only generic folder behavior.
